first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A foreground man with short brown hair, wearing a dark blue-gray top and brown trousers, with a brown shoulder strap across the back, holding Weapon A.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: The damaged blue-green wooden counter in front of Person A, with uneven countertop boards and an exposed frame in many places.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: The red rectangular shop stall on the right side of the passageway, with a gray roller shutter bearing a large red pattern.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: The gray-brown flagstone ground extending between the stalls toward the blue-and-white steps.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: The distant light-colored multi-story building with a curved corner and green balcony edges.

entities.name: armed person near the steps
entities.identification: The retained source group of people, including the person standing beside the orange-fruit table and the people lying in front of the blue-and-white steps.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: The fixed goods stall at the right edge, with a green panel with peeling paint, diagonal braces, and multiple tiers of open shelves.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: The low orange slatted display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: The multi-level steps extending laterally across the far end of the passageway, with small light-blue and white square tiles arranged on the risers.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The handgun held by Person A, with a small gray-silver upper section and a grip mostly occluded by the hand.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: The light-blue sky and patches of pale white cloud visible between the rooftops.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: The buildings on both sides of the passageway that are not separately listed, including blue-gray and yellow-brown walls.

entities.name: hanging green plants along the building edge
entities.identification: Clusters of green vegetation hanging downward from high balconies and eaves.

entities.name: light-colored cloth bag
entities.identification: The bulging beige-gray bag-shaped object on the green foreground counter.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The collection of containers comprising bottles and jars at the stalls and buckets and basins under tables and near the counter.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: The collection of fruit on the orange-fruit table, with oval fruit bodies and crowns of pointed leaves.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: Rectangular stacked goods of varying sizes on the small table and elsewhere, with beige-gray, brown, and blue-gray box surfaces.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: The narrow light-green wooden table on the near side of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with thin legs and a crossbar.

entities.name: overhead cables
entities.identification: The thin black lines suspended high between the market buildings.

entities.name: distant person's long gun
entities.identification: The dark firearm held by the standing person near the steps, identified separately from Weapon A and Weapon C.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: Light-gray and off-white sheet-like scattered objects of varying sizes on the flagstone passageway.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: The reflective water surface with irregular edges in low areas of the wet flagstones.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The armed person partially entering the frame at the image-left edge, with the forearm, hand, and a small portion of a reddish-brown sleeve clearly discernible.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The dull-gray short gun-shaped weapon held by Person C and raised toward the passageway.
